column1: # Natural commands with no keyphrase of their intent, for the LLM probe (cmd/intent-audit -llm, robot-wake T7):
# indirect requests the keyphrase matcher cannot answer. lang\ttext\texpected\tsource

column2: Could you head back to your dock?
Your battery must be low, go recharge.
I think it's time for you to rest for a while.
Move away from the edge, back off.
Can you look at my face?
Go have a look around the room.
Bring me that little block of yours.
I'm heading out now, see ya.
Tienes poca batería, ve a recargar.
Creo que necesitas descansar un rato.
Aléjate del borde, échate para atrás.
Recorre la habitación a ver qué encuentras.
Enséñame cómo te mueves con música.
